diagnosis.root_cause: The inventory service process shut down at 13:39:58 (uvicorn graceful shutdown) and has not come back. Its hostname no longer resolves, so shop gets 'Temporary failure in name resolution' on every call to inventory and returns 502s on /products and /orders. This is an infrastructure or container-level outage, not a code regression.
evidence: inventory logs show 'Shutting down', 'Waiting for application shutdown.', 'Application shutdown complete.' and 'Finished server process [1]' at 13:39:58, and no startup logs afterwards in the last 5 minutes.
Normal inventory traffic (POST /reservations, GET /products/10) stops at 13:39:58, which is exactly when the alert starts (13:39:59).

shop logs 'upstream unavailable' for target=inventory with ConnectError('[Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution'): 562 occurrences from 13:39:59 onwards, which are NEW compared with 0 in the previous hour. The first failure at 13:39:58.823 was 'All connection attempts failed'.
Metric upstream_requests_total shows shop->inventory status=error rising to 8.9/s, with no 200 or 201 responses to inventory.
Postgres logs show only routine checkpoints, so the database is not the cause. Inventory's memory metric is flat, and there is no sign of an OOM or crash trace.

The only recent commit, d8ba2d5 (13:38:38), changes a docstring in services/inventory/handlers.py and has no runtime effect, so it is not the culprit. The other commit, 7eafe18, is documentation only.
The earlier name-resolution errors against users (13:35:54-13:37:57) had stopped before the alert and belong to a previous, resolved incident.
plan: Restart the inventory service or container and confirm it starts, registers its DNS name and logs a normal uvicorn startup.
Check that shop->inventory upstream_requests_total returns to 200/201 and that the status=error series falls to 0.
Check that the shop 5xx rate returns to baseline and that GET /products and POST /orders no longer return 502.

Find out why inventory was stopped at 13:39:58 (orchestrator or container events, deploy triggered by commit d8ba2d5, or a manual stop). Add restart policy and health-check alerting for it if they are missing.

action.reason: The inventory process was shut down at 13:39:58 and never restarted, so its name does not resolve and shop cannot reach it. Restarting it should restore the service.
evidence: Uvicorn shutdown sequence logged at 13:39:58, with no subsequent startup logs.
shop reports DNS 'Temporary failure in name resolution' for target=inventory from 13:39:59 onwards.
No inventory requests were served after 13:39:58, and Postgres is healthy.
